name: Hensel Mi_01xx electrical enclosure component
aliases: Hensel Mi_01xx electrical enclosure component GA
summary: Mi_01xx electrical enclosure component arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: Mi_01xx is the drawing identifier for electrical enclosure component in Hensel's ENYMOD Mi enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. An electrical enclosure component houses or supports part of an electrical assembly. A complete arrangement must also include the selected lid or door, internal mounting and cable-entry details.

For example, in an industrial junction enclosure beside a field cable route, use the Mi_01xx reference to coordinate lid or door access, mounting points and cable-entry faces. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Mi_01xx.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep lid or door access, mounting points and cable-entry faces visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named Mi_01xx drawing and its electrical enclosure component role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
